comment: Lectures were extremely inefficient, and his explanations were often unhelpful. Does not provide adequate materials for exam preparation. Worst math teacher I have had.
Genuinely this is the kind of class you study HOURS for and still do poorly. something about the way the material is taught is insanely ineffective and confusing.

I pay $60,000 per year to attend the UofR. Someone, tell me why this nut job is teaching me calculus. I walked out of every calculus class with fewer brain cells than when I walked in. The homework took hours, the lectures barely made any sense, and he ignored the syllabus all year. If you genuinely want to learn, DON'T TAKE DR. K.

Do not take. Dr K is a very nice and sometimes funny teacher who knows what he's doing, but doesn't know how to teach it. His homework is a disaster, long and hard, while being full of content often not taught in class. His tests are difficult but content to be expected is clear, same for quizzes. He expects you to have taken calc in High school.

You need prior calculus experience for this class. The professor explains poorly, focuses too much on proofs, and drags out simple topics. He assigns lots of homework and can be snarky about mistakes. The only positives are generous partial credit and practice tests that sometimes match the real ones.

His class is very difficult ESPECIALLY if you have not taken Calculus before. Each class is a lecture but it is not based on anything specific he just lectures on what he wants to. He usually makes the homework questions himself and they are wordy and confusing (and he often messes up the question). He grades the homework very strictly.
I knew more about calculus going into the class than I did leaving

This guy can't teach, homeworks take forever, and he goes on insanely long tangents that have nothing to do with calc. Class could be taught better by a child. Barely scraped away with a B+ and I later got a A in calc 3.

He thinks he's Pythagoras himself...
He would spend time teaching pointless ways of doing things rather than what you should learn in calc (I took calc in HS). Half of the material on his final we were never taught and it tanked my GPA. DO NOT TAKE KERCKHOVE!!!

Genuinely an okay class! But if you've yet to have that one difficult class that also teaches you how to be a better student, this is not the place to learn that you either attend office hours or get a 70 on the homework. Sometimes you can do all that and still get a meh grade. Tread lightly; pros include seats always being open during registration
Definitely pushes you, but happy to help and super available for office hours. If you put in the work, the class is very rewarding

Would have given him a 0 if it were possible. Never received a syllabus for this course and he changed the layout of the course around his travel schedule for conferences. Horrible lecturer. Condescending. Only graded on homework and exams (which were supposed to be take home, but he went on a trip so they were given in class). Do not take!!

This guy was genuinely mean. I'm not even talking about how difficult the course was, he would mock students in class and laugh out loud when they asked questions. Homework was very difficult, took 2+ hours, and we didn't get much time to complete it. That being said, his study guides were very helpful. GO TO OFFICE HOURS.

He is atrociously bad. I''m talking completely awful. Do not, under any circumstances, ever take him, Wait a semester and try to find any other teacher.

He assumes that we already know the content and thus doesn't teach us. He doesn't post the homework until days after the class, at which point you've already forgotten much of what he talked about

Would not recommend to anyone sadly. Very very smart man and knows his stuff but teaches as if students already know the material. Don't even bother asking questions because you will still be confused. Expect to learn most things on your own. Hw assignments took about 2-5 hours. Unnecessarily difficult class that would be easier with other prof

The worst class I have ever taken at UR. Homework takes hours, is on topics not covered in class, and is graded on accuracy. The quizzes can be hard to study for and exams have questions that we haven't learned how to do. Took AP calc in high school and did well, this class is not designed well, considering I did worse. Do not take.

do not take him. i read the reviews on RMP, and thought what could be so bad? everything. he goes off topic the whole time and we only go through one problem the whole class. he makes us do the problem before he teaches it. the TAs grade our homework. its the second week of classes and dropping this guy. i have no idea why he still has a job
Super oblivious to pretty much everything at all times. Assumes we know topics of calculus when there is no reason we should know them. Never communicates with us as a class. Doesn't explain anything

Dr. K sometimes goes fast over complex steps in problems which can make his lectures hard to follow. He was happy to go over my many questions about intricacies in the lectures and help me understand the topic on a deeper level. I am super glad I took him and am better at math for it.

Dr. Kerchkove is very bad at explaining even simple topics, often going on tangents about real world problems he likes that leave the students even more confused. I took calculus in high school and he made topics I already knew confusing with new terminology. The web assigns are tedious, but they have little to do with his tests.

Don't. Do not take calc with professor K. He is a great person but a terrible teacher. The things he taught in class were completely different than what was in the required textbook; super confusing and doesn't answer questions well. Really try to take another professor if you want/need to take calc.

He isnt great at explaining things, but he moves really slowly so its easy to teach yourself on the side. He tries to make jokes and make math real life which is helpful. I think the tests are a big step up from the Webassigns but we practice most of the problems the day before during review. He shares the class notes and sends a lot of emails too
Do not

Class is mostly tests and online (webassign) homework. His tests are a decent difficulty but he gives points for partial credit and disregards problems if everyone gets it wrong. The webassign homework is kinda time consuming, but not too bad. Class is just notes/lecture. Decent class, if you took calc in hs you will do fine if you put in some work

BEWARE OF BAD REVIEWS. Most people suck at math (me too) and hate on Dr K. He is honestly the nicest professor I have had at UR; always willing to help out his students. He really cares about IQS and goes out of his way to make math fun and that the goals of the program are being met. As for IQS... don't take if you have any of those credits.

Absolutely do not take this class with Dr. K unless youve taken a calc class before. He is very nice but does not explain things well at all. The tests are impossible to study for as things you did not do in class could be on them.

I had never taken Calculus in high school, so I was screwed from the start in Dr. K's class. The way the textbook solves problems vs how he teaches them makes homework take at least 2 hours. Tests and quizzes have very few problems so if you miss one thing, say goodbye to an A. Sad that he isn't even the worst calc teacher

Dr. K can be confusing in his lectures and has some trouble communicating his ideas to students, but he is also super nice and cares a lot about each student. He is very helpful during office hours and is always willing to meet with students, so if you're struggling go see him!!! If you can't go to his office hours he always answers his email too!

He is a very nice and funny guy, but not a great teacher. If I hadn't taken calculous once before I would have failed this class miserably. I dont know how I would have understood any of the concepts just based on his teaching
This guy is brutal. Class lecture has nothing to do with homework or tests. First test is easy, but after that you're donzo. This clown doesn't deserve a job here anymore.

Kerckhove is a very nice man and he made learning math fun. However, if you have never taken calc before you are screwed. If you ask a question he often times makes you feel stupid even if that isn't his intention. Lectures are easy to follow but his tests are unpredictable and hard to study for but he makes himself easily accessible which helps

I only rate this guy a 4 because all of the other calc teachers at UR are absolute trash. He's kind of funny, which is amazing considering he's teaching math, and he's pretty willing to help people outside of class. For someone who hates calculus with a firey passion I at least somewhat enjoyed his class.
Great guy!
Dr. K is so nice and truly cares about his students! He is very accessible to students and makes his class enjoyable

Dr. K is definitely not an easy A but you should take his class if you're interested in Math. Read the section before he introduces it in class  or else you'll struggle to understand what he says. His lecture notes and homeworks are helpful. His in semester tests aren't that easy but the final is super easy (GO for the review sessions!)

Dr. Kerckhove is very laid back, perhaps to a fault. His lectures aren't that bad though, I could follow along his logic - although sometimes he would go off-topic or throw something out of nowhere. But, he is very nice and pretty funny. I enjoyed his class, and would take again.

He was able to pretty clearly teach certain concepts in this class because they were so repetitive and linked together, but his lectures seem to be not as explanatory as they should be. It's a bit hard to prepare for his tests because he likes to use truefalse questions that require a deep level of explanation.
He is one of the greatest professors. If you have low scores, that is because of your faults, not his. Work harder to get high scores instead of whining here.

Dr. Kerckhove is obviously brilliant, but he doesn't know how to communicate his ideas. Most students in the class were better off not paying attention during lecture. Overall a nice, helpful guy, but very hard to understand.

Impossible to follow in lecture. He is unable to explain what he is thinking and the connections is making. HW took HOURS, even with 5 people working together. Test questions were nothing you could study for. Thank god for the other subjects in the class or I would have not done well.
terrible terrible terrible. he's too smart to be able to explain anything on our level and gets huffy when we ask questions
He never explains unless asked about 100 times in 100 different ways. I want to shoot myself.
Don't read other postings. Tests are not bad at all. I suck at math but I pulled of 92 on two tests ending the semester with B+. Office hours help a lot.

Dr. K is actually pretty cool despite what your read here. Yes, he sometimes goes on fruitless tangents, but I always found it more endearing than annoying. He teaches the material, and his reviews are helpful before the tests.
tests are impossible
Cool. Warm.
Worst teacher I've had here- incomprehensible and kind of mean.
No Comments

The worst teacher ever, if you are in his class drop it and find a new teacher if possible.  He is very unclear, and you never know what is going on.  I got a 97 in calc. in high school and i have around a B- now.  Even if you know your material you do not know what he is asking for on the test.
sucks
I'm SURE that this man is a genius but i had him the first year he taught core. i think he was just trying to get situated. I will remeber him forever. I think our brains are just wired differently.
not good at teaching in front of a big class, but really good at explaining things one-on-one.  final was surprisingly easy after a really hard class.
If he likes your writing style, you're set.  Class discussions are absurdly abstract and have no relevance to the course (although the course itself doesn't have any relevance).
worst teacher i've had so far at richmond

This man is probably the worst teacher in the world.  He is highly inappropriate at times and does not at all understand how to lead discussions. He basically thinks he is Socrates with his "teaching methods" and paper comments. Avoid taking him at all costs.

i'm a math major so i knew this class would be hard but this guy is terrible. my friend had him for calc 2 and he curved BACKWARD. as in everyone did well on his test and he didnt like that so he gave them worse grades. DO NOT TAKE HIM. he makes u feel like an idiot and your grade will reflect that.

Avoid taking him if at all possible. Our class was horrible because Dr. K could never lead discussions and if we so happened to actually have one (without his help of course), he would somehow kill it. Very unclear about assignments and hard grader.
Worst core professer ever. Sometimes has very unappropiate discussions in class with students. Not clear with paper topics. Grades are arbitrary. Just horrible

This is the only teacher that ever made me cry (due to frustration). I ended up getting an A- but I worked really hard and spent lots of time (including Friday afternoons/evenings) in extra help sessions.
very difficult teacher, wasn't clear in what he taught.  Teaching yourself is the only way to do well on his exams.  Strange guy, make sure you really like math before you take his class.
No Comments

Dr. K is the worst professor ever.  I hate to say this because he is a really nice guy, but he is so unclear in what he talks about, you never know whats going on.  To top things off, he changed the grading scale after the final to make it harder.

Dr. K is a really nice guy if you get on his good side.  Don't think you can slack on papers just cause he's a math teacher.  He's very very socratic, and never actually tells you anything.  You feel like you're tryin to read his mind all the time.
